p: the third day: After that he departed from Achish.
smitten Ziklag: That is, destroyed their city.
wives: For those only remained in the city, when the men were gone to war.
spake of stoning him: Thus we see that in trouble and adversity we do not consider God's providence, but like raging beasts forget both our own duty and contemn God's appointment over us.
recover all: Though God seem to leave us for a time, yet if we trust in him, we will be sure to find comfort.
bread: God by his providence both provides for the needs of the poor stranger, and made him a guide to David to accomplish his enterprise.
Swear unto me by God: For others were in all ages held in most reverence, even among the heathen.
The wicked in their pomp and pleasures do not consider the judgment of God, which is then at hand to smite them.
of the next day: Some read, and to the morrow of the two evenings, that is, three days.
spoil: Which the Amalekites had taken from others, and David from them, besides the goods of Ziklag.
wife and his children: Under these are understood the cattle and goods, which belonged to every man.
And it was so from that: Some refer these words to David, that he alleged an old custom and law, as if it were written, it is both now, and ever has been.
to all the places where David: Showing himself mindful of their benefits towards him.
